relevant_laws.quote: Whenever an illuminated flashing red or yellow signal is used in conjunction with an official traffic-control device, it shall require obedience by vehicular traffic as follows: When a yellow lens is illuminated with rapid intermittent flashes, drivers of vehicles may proceed past such signal and through the intersection or other hazardous location only with caution.
relevant_laws.notes: The frozen intersection/through-lane signal cell supports measured yellow-lens passage; actual official status and caution remain open.
